title: Stickyflow PM logbook - day capture
content:
2024-10-22 (Tue) - quick capture - staggered brain dump

Top 3 MITs for today:
- Final pass on PRD section: rollout + fallback (AC + rollout steps). Estimated 45m.
- Ping infra + SRE for canary capacity confirmation (need explicit headroom numbers).
- Draft stakeholder note about cutover window + rollback criteria.

Morning run notes:
- PRD edits: clarified acceptance criteria for model variant fallback (if p50 latency > 120ms for 2 consecutive minutes then route to -lite). Added metric: tokens/sec per GPU, and a note to surface if degraded by >25% vs baseline.
- Removed ambiguous line about "should be transparent" and replaced with specific trace points (trace-id, request-tag header).
- Need a short paragraph explaining why caching TTL = 5s default (workload profile + privacy).

Follow-ups (owners / intended message):
- @Jordan: confirm the dedicated pool autoscale min/target for canary — I need numbers by EOD. (Slack DM sent, no reply)
- @Priya: can you run a quick eval on the prompts we flagged for hallucination risk? If pass, we add to smoke gating. (Linked test set: RED-3421)
- @Cory (SRE): ask for alert runbook snippet to include in launch doc (who paged, playbook, ops contact).

Launch checklist (in-progress):
[ ] Canary deploy to eu-west-1 (2x small nodes)
[ ] Set canary traffic at 2% for first 30m, 10% next hour, then 100% when healthy
[ ] Enable structured logging for function-calls endpoint (temp retention 7d)
[ ] Pre-warm KV cache with top-100 prefixes (script ready: scripts/prewarm.sh)
[ ] Post-deploy smoke: 10 synthetic sessions across seq lengths 64/512/1024
[ ] Run regression eval (perf + quality) and attach artefacts to runbook

Notes to self / questions to resolve:
- What is the rollback TTL for cached responses? If we rollback a model variant, ensure KV invalidation step included. Ticket idea: INF-rollback-cache-step.
- Should we include a temporary header for canary tagging (x-rw-canary: true) at LB or at runtime? LB gives clearer routing but requires infra change.
- Need to confirm billing impact of continuous sampling for quality monitoring (tokens sampled * 10% -> extra cost). Present numbers to finance.

Meeting prep (1:1 with Eng Lead at 11:30):
- ask: timeline risk areas (quantization regressions, kernel compatibility)
- propose: add "compat smoke" step to CI with lite-quantized model on A100
- bring up: tracing gaps — we still miss request tags for streamed responses

Quick draft of stakeholder message (to be polished):
Subject: Quick update: Canary plan + rollback criteria for feature X
Body: Hi team — aiming to start canary rollout Wed 10/23 09:00 PDT. Initial canary traffic 2% for 30m, then 10% for 1h. Rollback triggers include: sustained p50 latency >120ms for 2 consecutive minutes, error rate >1% for 5m, or quality regression +5% on flagged eval prompts. If rollback required we will: 1) route new traffic to baseline model, 2) invalidate KV cache, 3) run diagnostics and notify owners. CC: infra, SRE, QA.

Brainstorm snippets (parking lot):
- Post-launch: add experiment to test batch-size knob for latency/cost tradeoff per-route
- Consider "graceful degrade" UX story for downstream callers (header + warning code)

Clip of command outputs / quick probes (pasted):
- curl /health -> 200, mem: 12.1GB, load: 0.9
- perf-preview: p50=68ms, p95=220ms for seq=512 (local dry-run)

Housekeeping/to-dos (personal):
- archive old PRD diff into /archive (5m)
- update the runbook checkboxes after Jordan reply (2m)
- follow up with legal on data retention note for private deployments (email template ready)

End-of-day reflection (quick):
- progress = solid draft of rollout + fallback; still need infra numbers and SRE playbook snippet. Keep push for clarity on cache invalidation.

-- Maya

(rough, messy. will trim and move to shared drive runbook when stable)
